tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// bstod pa rgyas pa bzhugs// ༄༅// bcom ldan 'das 'od zer can ma'i bstod pa/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'od zer dam pa'i 'od mdzad pas// snang ba dam pa'i dpal bskyed pa// 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal nas// de nyid la ni bstod par bgyi// bcom ldan rnam snang mdzad dpal gyi// gnyis med ye shes 'od zer las// kun nas yongs su rnam 'phrul ba// 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo// nyid gnas nam mkha'i klong dkyil du// yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor dbus// ham̐ las sgra gcan 'dzin chen po// nyi zla 'dzin pa 'gyel pa'i steng*// ram̐ las rin chen shing rta mchog /phag bdun gyis ni drangs pa'i khrir// pam̐ las 'dab brgyad pad+ma'i dbus// ram̐ skyes nyi ma'i gdan la 'dud// de yi steng du oṃ yig las// rnam par snang mdzad zla ba'i mdog /byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can// kun tu zhal la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs kar zla steng sa bon mam̐// sngags kyi phreng dang bcas pa'i 'od// 'phros 'dus gcig tu gyur pa las// 'khrungs pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das ma gser mdog can// zhal gsum phyag brgyad zhal re zhing*// spyan gsum 'dzum khro'i tshul can ma// g.yon brkyang rol pas bzhugs la 'dud// zhal g.yas dmar zhing rjes chags ma// g.yon pa phag zhal dbang sngon mdog /rngam zhing khro la drag tu sgrogs// rgyan rnams kun gyis sgeg la 'dud// rdo rje lcags kyu mda' dang khab// phyag g.yas rnams kyis rim bzhin bsnams// g.yon rnams mya ngan med dang gzhu// skud pa sdigs mdzub bcas la 'dud// lwa ba'i stod g.yogs dmar po dang*// sna tshogs dar gyi sham thabs can// spyi gtsug rnam par snang mdzad kyis// rnam par brgyan la phyag 'tshal lo// shar gyi 'dab mar nyi ma'i steng*// mam̐ yig sngags bcas las skyes zhing*// pad+ma rā ga ltar snang ba'i// ba ta li la phyag 'tshal lo// zhal gcig phyag bzhi phag gdong ma// khab dang lcags kyu g.yas pas 'dzin// zhags pa mya ngan med pa'i shing*// g.yon pas bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// lwa dmar am̐ ga rag dang ni// stag gi pags pa'i smad g.yogs can// sbrul dang rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan// 'jigs gzugs ma la phyag 'tshal lo// ma rungs pa rnams 'gugs pa dang*// gsod pa'i las la rab brtson zhing*// khyad par klu dang sa bdag rnams// 'dul bar mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// lho yi 'dab mar nyi ma'i steng*// mam̐ yig sngags bcas la skyes zhing*// gser bzang 'bar ba'i mdog mtshungs pa// ba da lī la phyag 'tshal lo// zhal gcig phyag bzhi rab mdzes ma// g.yas pa a shwa ka dang khab// g.yon pa gnyis kyis rdo rje dang*// zhags pa bsnams pa phyag 'tshal lo// gzhon nu lang tsho rab rgyas shing*// sna tshogs dar gyi na bza' dang*// rin chen rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan// yid 'phrog ma la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro la rin chen char 'bebs pas// dbul ba'i 'jigs pa rnam sel zhing*// gdug can rnams kyi kha mig dang*// yan lag 'ching mdzad khyod la 'dud// nub kyi 'dab mar nyi ma'i steng*// mam̐ yig sngags bcas las skyes zhing*// puṇ+ḍa rī ka'i mdog mtshungs ma// ba ra li la phyag 'tshal lo// zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan yangs ma// phyag g.yas rdo rje dang ni khab// zhags pa mya ngan med pa'i shing*// g.yon pas bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dar gyi na bza' rab gsol zhing*// rin chen me tog tshogs kyis spras// g.yon brkyang ba yi skyil krung gis// rnam par bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba rnams kyi sdig pa dang*// gnod pa zhi ba'i 'od mdzad cing*// gdug pa can rnams rengs mdzad ma// lha mo dgyes dgur spyod la 'dud// byang gi 'dab mar nyi ma'i steng*// mam̐ yig sngags bcas las skyes zhing*// pad+ma rā ga'i mdog mtshungs ma// ba ra ha mu khe la 'dud// zhal gcig phyag bzhi phag gdong ma// spyan gsum phyag g.yas rdo rje mda'// zhags pa mya ngan med pa'i shing*// g.yon pas bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// stod g.yogs dmar po'i am̐ ga rag

/sna tshogs dar gyi sham thabs can// sbrul dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras// khro zhing sgeg pa khyod la 'dud// lha dang lha min klu dbang dang*// mi dang gnod sbyin 'byung po'i tshogs// dbang du sdud cing myos mdzad ma// yid 'ong ma la phyag 'tshal lo// rin chen sna tshogs las grub pa'i// bum bzang bdud rtsis yongs gang bas// pad+ma'i mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhir// gnas pa la yang phyag 'tshal lo// lha mo mchog gi rjes 'brangs pa// nyi ma zla ba sgra gcan dang*// gza' dang rgyu skar thams cad de// kun sdud ma la phyag 'tshal lo// phyogs skyong rnams dang lha rnams dang*// rgyal chen bzhi dang gnod sbyin dang*// klu dbang rnams dang lha min gyis// mchod pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// nyan thos rnams dang rang rgyal dang*// sems dpa' rnams kyis bkur bgyis shing*// rgyal ba yis kyang bsngags bgyis pa// phyag byar 'os pa khyod la 'dud// bsam mi khyab pa'i gnas brnyes ma// khyed la skye 'gag ma mchis slad// 'gro dang 'ong ba ga la mchis// gnas bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// de lta mod kyi kun 'gro yi// rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs brnyes pas// skad cig gcig la'ang yul kun du// khyab par gshegs pa khyod la 'dud// de slad 'di nas khyod byon la// 'dir ni gshegs par 'gyur ro zhes// su zhig gis ni bstan par nus// dpag yas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'on kyang gnas dus nges pa la// mos pa'i 'gro rnams rjes gzung phyir// nyi ma zla ba'i mdun nas khyod// gshegs par ston la phyag 'tshal lo// de lta mod kyi nyi 'od kyis// 'byung po'i bya rnams long pa ltar// khyod kyi 'od kyis rmugs bgyis pa'i// 'byung pos khyod bltar mi nus na// gzung ba dang ni bcing ba dang*// dgag pa dang ni brgal ba dang*// dbang du bgyi bar smos ci 'tshal// dbang phyug dam pa khyod la 'dud// khyod lta zhog gi khyod kyi mtshan// tshul bzhin 'dzin pa gang lags pa// de yang de 'dra nyid mdzad pa'i// mdzad pa dam pa khyod la 'dud// de slad bdag gis khyod kyi mtshan// 'dzin zhing tshul bzhin mas bgyis kyis// bdag kyang de 'drar phyogs kun las// rnam par rgyal bar mdzad du gsol// bdag dang bdag gi gnyen bshes kun// lam dang de bzhin lam log dang*// skye bos 'jigs dang rgyal rigs kyi// 'jigs pa kun las bskyab tu gsol// de bzhin glang chen chom rkun dang*// seng ge stag dang me dang chu// sbrul dang dug dang phyir rgol dang*// dgra yi 'jigs pa kun las skyob// bdag ni gnas skabs thams cad du// ji lta'i tshul gyis gnas kyang rung*// gdon rims 'khrug pa thams cad las// kun nas yongs su bsrung du gsol// khyod la nye bar bsten pa'i 'bangs// bdag cag rnams la 'tshe bgyid pa// de dag khyod kyi mngon spyod kyi// las kyis gdul bar mdzad du gsol// gang dag khyod la skyabs pa dang*// gang gzhan khyod la mi 'dud pa// de dag mtshungs pa mdzad na ko

/gzhan du ji ltar yal bar 'dor// gdug pa rnams ni tshar gcod dang*// nyam thag dbugs 'byin mdzad pa dag /legs par sgrub pa rjes 'dzin pa// khyod kyi dam bca' ma lags sam// gal te las la rag las na// las tshul so sor spyad pa'i 'bras// de des nyams su myong ba la// khyod kyis phrin las ci zhig 'tshal// de slad khyod la skyabs pa dang*// skyob pa mchog la gsol ba dang*// de yi sngags la 'bad bgyis pa'i// ngal ba 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// nor bu dpag bsam shing sogs kyis// 'gro ba'i re ba rdzogs bgyid na// khyod ni brtse chen thams cad mkhyen// mthu chen mnga' bas smos ci 'tshal// zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /dbye dang bskrad dang gsad la sogs// bdag gis gang dag don gnyer ba// las de dag ni grub par mdzod// ral gri mig sman ri lu dang*// mi snang ba dang bcud kyis len// rkang mgyogs sa 'og gter dang ni// bu mo dam pa dgug pa dang*// rig 'dzin mkha' la spyod pa dang*// 'khor los sgyur ba'i dpal rgyas dang*// grol dang rnam grol mchog rnams kyi// dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol// bcom ldan 'od zer can ma la// bstod pa'i dge bas bdag gzhan kun// chos dang phrin las sna tshogs kyis// 'od mdzad chos kyi rgyal por shog /rgyal po chen po'i pho brang du bcom ldan 'das ma 'od zer can ma mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas par byed pa'i ched du/ bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa 'di lcags pho rta'i lo// dbyar zla 'bring po'i tshes nyi shu lnga la/ dge slong sngags 'chang ba 'phags pas sbyar ba'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
